_readme: Every rate, threshold and taper the engines use. Read on the Guides to Social Policy Law (Department of Social Services) on the date in retrieved_at; copies of each page are in research/. Never type one of these numbers in a page: read it from here (RECETTE §4, §17.4 point 7). Fortnightly figures for social security payments are those of 20 September 2026; FTB, CCS and PPL figures are those of the 2026-27 income year (1 July 2026).
